Grid Reliability Engineer

Calgary, Canada | Onsite / Hybrid
Full-time, Permanent

Why join Cognite Workforce

Cognite Workforce runs the analytics layer behind a hardening electric grid. We are looking for a Grid Reliability Engineer who can turn outage telemetry into forecasting signals we can act on.

Key responsibilities

  • Own reliability models that ingest SCADA telemetry at scale.
  • Write and tune forecasting jobs on our analytics platform.
  • Define runbooks and lead tabletop exercises with operators.

Your background

  • Degree in engineering, physics, or a related field.
  • Experience with time-series data pipelines and Python.
  • Familiarity with utility operations is a strong plus.
